#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""上传定稿日报到技术体系工作报告云端（report/submit）。

用法:
  python3 .cursor/scripts/upload_work_report.py --file .cursor/work-log/reports/日报-2026-09-10.md
  python3 .cursor/scripts/upload_work_report.py --date 2026-09-10

凭据：~/Downloads/工作报告/config.js（apiToken / empId）
API：https://ep.jsyyds.com/api/v1/report/submit
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_URL = "https://ep.jsyyds.com/api/v1/report/submit"
CONFIG = Path.home() / "Downloads" / "工作报告" / "config.js"
REPORTS = Path("/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.cursor/work-log/reports")
MEMORY_REPORTS = Path.home() / ".dc-platform" / "memory" / "work-log" / "reports"


def _parse_config(path: Path) -> dict:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    for k in ("empId", "apiToken", "name", "org", "level", "role"):
        m = re.search(rf"{k}:\s*'([^']*)'", text)
        if m:
            out[k] = m.group(1)
    if not out.get("empId") or not out.get("apiToken"):
        raise SystemExit(f"config missing empId/apiToken: {path}")
    return out


def _resolve(date: str | None, file: str | None) -> tuple[Path, str]:
    if file:
        p = Path(file).expanduser().resolve()
        if not p.is_file():
            raise SystemExit(f"file not found: {p}")
        m = re.search(r"(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})", p.name)
        day = date or (m.group(1) if m else "")
        if not day:
            raise SystemExit("cannot infer date; pass --date")
        return p, day
    if not date:
        raise SystemExit("need --date or --file")
    for root in (REPORTS, MEMORY_REPORTS):
        for name in (f"日报-{date}.md", f"{date}-日报.md"):
            p = root / name
            if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size > 0:
                return p, date
    raise SystemExit(f"no report for {date}")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Upload daily work report (verbatim)")
    ap.add_argument("--date", help="YYYY-MM-DD")
    ap.add_argument("--file", help="Markdown path (verbatim content)")
    ap.add_argument("--type", default="日报", help="report_type, default 日报")
    ap.add_argument("--url", default=DEFAULT_URL)
    ap.add_argument("--config", default=str(CONFIG))
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    path, day = _resolve(args.date, args.file)
    content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if not content.strip():
        raise SystemExit(f"empty report: {path}")
    cfg = _parse_config(Path(args.config))

    payload = {
        "emp_id": cfg["empId"],
        "report_date": day,
        "report_type": args.type,
        "content": content,
        "token": cfg["apiToken"],
    }

    if args.dry_run:
        print(f"dry-run file={path} day={day} emp={cfg['empId']} chars={len(content)}")
        return 0

    body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        args.url,
        data=body,
        method="POST",
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8"},
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        err = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        print(f"ERROR HTTP {e.code}: {err}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        print(raw)
        return 1

    print(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    # friendly one-liner
    rid = data.get("id") or data.get("data", {}).get("id") if isinstance(data.get("data"), dict) else data.get("id")
    status = data.get("status") or data.get("action") or data.get("data", {})
    if isinstance(status, dict):
        status = status.get("status") or status.get("action") or status
    print(f"OK day={day} file={path} emp={cfg['empId']} id={rid} status={status}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
